name: Carved Centaur Totems
summary: Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point seeks carved centaur totems to imitate their designs. He hopes the copies can help buy an advantage with the centaur clans.

sections.title: A Bargain in Wood
sections.body: Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point looks to the centaur clans' carved wood for a way to gain an advantage. Both clans hesitate to accept aid from outsiders, especially non-centaurs. He asks you to bring him samples of their designs so he can arrange similar carvings.

faq.q: Why does Captain Pentigast want the totems?
faq.answer: He hopes to arrange similar carvings and buy an advantage with the centaur clans.

faq.q: Why are the centaur clans hesitant to accept help?
faq.answer: Both clans hesitate to accept aid from outside their clan, especially from non-centaurs.

faq.q: What are the centaur totems made of?
faq.answer: The local centaur barter with carved wood.
Captain Pentigast is at Nijel's Point.

attribution: In-game quest text: Carved Centaur Totems
